pain.title: You boosted. The likes came. The sales didn't.
paragraphs: You made a nice flyer. You tapped Boost. GHS 50 here, GHS 200 there. The notifications felt good — reactions, shares, plenty "DM please."
Then the quiet. Two orders, maybe. Or none. And a voice inside said what so many Ghanaian business owners end up believing: "ads don't work for my kind of business."
pain.kicker: The ads were never the problem. The system around the ads was missing — and nobody sold you the system. Until now.

leaks.title: Seven leaks. One playbook that plugs them all.
leaks.description: If you've read our free guide, you know the leaks. The Ad Engine™ is the full repair manual — every leak, plugged, in order.

items.title: Leak 4 — Targeting everyone

items.title: Leak 5 — One ad, no testing

items.title: Leak 6 — Judging by likes

items.title: Leak 7 — Flying blind
items.description: No tracking, no learning, no compounding.

reveal.title: Not a course. Not theory. An engine.

paragraphs.text: Most ad training is built for oyibo markets with credit cards and websites. The Ad Engine™ is built for how Ghana actually buys — WhatsApp conversations, MoMo payments, delivery riders, and customers whose scam-radar is always on.
paragraphs.strong: The Ad Engine™ is built for how Ghana actually buys

paragraphs.text: You follow it in order: fix the foundation, load a real offer, launch your blueprint, feed the winner, kill the loser — then service the engine 15 minutes every Monday. That's the whole job.
No marketing degree. No big budget. The methods scale from GHS 20 a day to GHS 500 a day — the ratios are what matter, and they're all inside.

fit.title: Who this is for — and who should skip it.

yes.title: The Ad Engine™ is for you if…
items: You run a real business in Ghana and sell through WhatsApp, a shop, or a website.
You've boosted posts and felt the disappointment — or never advertised and want to start right.
You can commit 15 minutes every Monday. That's the maintenance schedule.
You'd rather own the skill than rent it forever.

no.title: Skip it if…
items: You're looking for "make money online" magic. This is for businesses with a real product or service.
You want someone else to do everything — that's our management service, not this playbook.
You won't put a price in your ads or reply to customers promptly. No playbook survives that.

items.question: I've never run an ad in my life. Is this too advanced?
items.answer: It's built for you specifically. Part 1 assumes nothing — it walks you from creating your Business Manager account to your first proper campaign, in order, with everything unnecessary ignored. Owners who've boosted before will move faster, but beginners are the home crowd here.

items.question: Do I need a website?
items.answer: No. The playbook's main path runs on WhatsApp — where most Ghanaian sales actually close. If you do have a website, there's a track for the Pixel and the Sales objective too.

items.question: How big a budget do I need?
items.answer: The methods are budget-flexible by design. The blueprints show you starting structures you can run modestly and scale only when your own numbers prove it's working. The whole system is built to stop waste first — most owners find the playbook pays for itself in ad money it stops them burning.

items.question: How is this delivered?
items.answer: Instantly, on WhatsApp. Send "ENGINE", complete payment via MoMo or transfer, and the playbook arrives in your chat within minutes. [DELIVERY METHOD — confirm exact flow before launch.]

items.question: What if I'd rather someone just ran my ads for me?
items.answer: That's our done-for-you service — a different thing at a different price. Honestly, many of our best management clients started with this playbook: they understand every report we send because they know how the engine works. Start where your time and budget make sense.

items.question: Is this only for the six business types listed?
items.answer: No — those six cover the most common cases, but the blueprints are structures you can adapt, and the playbook shows you which one fits businesses outside the list.
